title: Transduction of Cultured Cells with Recombinant Lentiviral Particles
protocol: Plate cells for transduction.
For 12-well plate: Plate 1 mL at 5.25 x 10^5 cells/mL of 16HBE, IMR90 at 6.4 x 10^4 cells/mL, HULEC at 8 x 10^4 cells/mL, and H441 at 2.0 x 10^5 cells/mL.
Incubate cells in a humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO₂ for 24 hours.
Determine cell density by warming appropriate cell culture medium and DPBS in 37°C water bath, and trypsin at room temperature.
Aspirate cell culture media from designated counting wells.
Rinse aspirated wells with DPBS.
Add 1 mL DPBS per well for a 12-well plate.
Aspirate PBS from each well and add 200 μL trypsin. Incubate at 37 °C for 7 minutes.
Neutralize trypsin by adding 1 mL culture media to each well. Triturate each cell suspension to break up clumps. Transfer the suspension to a labeled 15 mL tube per well.
Rinse each well with an additional 1 mL of culture media to collect remaining cells. Transfer to the matched 15 mL tube and vortex to mix the cell suspension.
Add DPBS to a new Eppendorf tube for each cell suspension to be counted, in appropriate amounts.
Make a 1:1 dilution by adding appropriate amounts of each cell suspension to the matched Eppendorf tubes.
Weigh approximately 100 mg of polybrene and add tissue culture grade water to prepare a stock solution at a concentration of 10 mg/mL.
Filter sterilize the polybrene solution in hood and store at 4°C.
Make an optimized polybrene dilution from 10 mg/ml stock in appropriate amount of growth medium in 15 ml conical tube. Mix well by vortexing.
Use 2 μg/ml polybrene for 16HBE cells.
Use 2 μg/ml polybrene for IMR90 cells.
Thaw aliquot(s) of recombinant lentiviral particles at room temperature.
Make aliquots of growth medium with X mg/mL polybrene for each well to be transduced in 50 mL conical tubes.
Add 800 μL of polybrene dilution per well to be transduced on a 12-well plate.
Include additional polybrene aliquots as a negative (no virus) transduction control.
Add optimized volume of viral particles to each polybrene dilution aliquot designated for viral transduction. Mix well by vortexing.
Remove plates designated for viral transduction from incubator and aspirate media from wells.
Aspirate media in a manner that minimizes cell-air contact time.
Add polybrene-virus mix or polybrene-no virus to appropriate wells.
Incubate in a humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO₂ for 24 hours.
Aspirate the transduction medium into a flask containing bleach.
Rinse wells with DPBS and aspirate the DPBS. Repeat twice for a total of three DPBS washes.
Add fresh growth medium to each plate of transduced cells.
Incubate cells in a humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO₂ for 48 hours.
Visualize fluorescent cells and/or quantify the percentage of fluorescent-positive cells by flow cytometry.
